doc: Labeled comp pairs for scripts/merge-eval.ts. expect: 'merge' = same archetype, 'split' = must stay separate. Comp ids come from /admin/inspector (member rows) or the pair-candidates listing. Seeded 2026-07-10 from live set-17 data, mirroring the /photos board-pair semantics; extend as new cases appear.

pairs.note: Lulu line: full hit (Jax/Lulu/Milio/Pantheon 3*) vs only-Lulu hit — photo pair 5
Lulu line: full hit vs no hits at all — misses pool into line EV

Lulu line: different secondary hits (Jax/Lulu/Pantheon vs Jax/Milio) — photo pair 4. Passing when seeded; 16.14-era data drifted the a-side archetype's hero-augment election to ##aug:Jax (rate straddles the 0.5 threshold), same detection boundary as the two known aug pairs below. Morde hero-augment satellite (##aug, damage-rate 1.0) vs the Illaoi/Kai'Sa/Karma line it splintered from — user-labeled 2026-07-15. The 3-star+damage-items heuristic cannot separate 'augment tank' from 'naturally hit tank' at comp grain: three-zone rate AND eligible-weighted rate both false-merged the Jax split pair when tuned to admit this one. Waiting on a real augment observable, or the user re-ruling the Jax pair as must-merge
